:::{#exr-prereq-logarithms}
#### Logarithms

Evaluate each of these without a calculator.

1. $\log_2 64$
2. $\log_3 \paren{1/9}$
3. $\log_2 \paren{8^5}$
4. Start at 1024 and halve it repeatedly.
   How many halvings does it take to reach 1?
5. $\floor{\log_2 100}$, where $\floor{x}$ is the largest integer that is at most $x$

:::
